explication: AlterSend is a cross-platform, end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer file-transfer product, with desktop and mobile send/receive clients and a browser-based receiver. The main workflow is to select files, establish a session using a join code or remembered pairing, transfer directly (with relay fallback), and download the received files. The graph combines documented product behavior with relationships visible in sampled source; unsampled app wiring is omitted or marked unverified.
